findings.description: TOCTOU race condition in PackageLoader directory check - directory existence check followed by file operations without atomic guarantee
findings.reasoning: The code checks if a directory exists with os.path.isdir(root) at line 355, but then uses this directory path later without ensuring it still exists or hasn't been modified. Between the check and subsequent use, an attacker could delete or replace the directory, leading to unexpected behavior or security issues.
